title: Binance Banking Triparty: 0% Fee Promotion Extended Through 2026 & Revised Tiered Fees from 2027
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are pleased to share two updates to the Binance Banking Triparty solution for our institutional and VIP clients: an extension of the zero-fee promotion through the end of 2026, and a revision in the tiered pricing rates that will apply thereafter from 2027. 0% Fee Promotion Extended to 2026-12-31: The Binance Banking Triparty zero-fee promotion has been extended until  2026-12-31 . All service fees on pledged funds continue to be fully waived for Banking Triparty clients through this date. This extension provides institutions with a further six months of fee-free access — an opportunity to maximize capital efficiency  and deepen engagement with the product before standard pricing takes effect. Revised Tiered Pricing (Effective 2027-01-01): From  2027-01-01 , a tiered pricing model will apply to Banking Triparty clients. We are pleased to announce that the rates have been  reduced by 2.5% across all tiers , reflecting the long-term value of the partnership and our commitment to providing institutional clients with competitive, sustainable pricing. The updated annual rates by collateral tiers are as follow: Tier Pledged Collateral Annual Rate (APR)* Tier 1 Up to $50 million 1.000% Tier 2 $50 million - $100 million 0.500% Tier 3 $100 million - $500 million 0.250% Tier 4 $500 million and above 0.100% *Rates are annual and apply to the total value of pledged collateral. Tier classification is based on pledged collateral at the time of assessment. About Binance Banking Triparty: Launched in November 2023, Binance Banking Triparty was the first crypto exchange-led triparty arrangement, built to bring institutional-grade custody infrastructure to the digital asset space. To date, Binance has partnered with 7 banking institutions, spanning top-tier, mid-sized, and API-enabled neo-banks, and continues to expand its network of Triparty banking partners. The solution allows institutions to hold collateral, including fiat currency (such as USD & CHF), Treasury Bills, BlackRock's BUIDL token, and Bitcoin (BTC), off-exchange, in their own corporate account, with a regulated third-party banking partner. Clients retain access to corresponding on-exchange liquidity on Binance, enabling them to trade without moving their collateral. The triparty model separates custody from execution, helping institutions manage counterparty risk in line with TradFi-standard operational practices while maintaining full access to Binance's liquidity depth. How to Get Started: VIP and Institutional users with a minimum pledged collateral of $10 million can reach out to their dedicated Key Account Manager to learn more or begin onboarding. If you are not yet a Binance VIP or Institutional user, please connect with our team via the Binance Banking Triparty form. Contact Our Team For more information, visit the  Binance VIP & Institutional official page  or contact your dedicated account manager. You can also connect with us on our official VIP  X  or  LinkedIn .
